end.summary:
Practised making one mark for each object.
Matched marks to objects to check for missing or extra objects.
Correctly identified 6 objects as 6 marks.
Correctly matched objects and marks in 3 attempts.
Explored that one unmatched mark can show one missing object.
end.parentNote: Parth practised keeping track by pairing one mark with each object, then checking the pairs for anything missing or extra. They correctly matched objects and marks several times. They first suggested erasing marks, but later described that one mark would remain when one object was missing, so this mix-up was partly corrected during the lesson. At home, use small items such as buttons and ask Parth to place one mark beside each item, then check the pairs one by one.
